_source: HCM 7th Edition, Chapter 34, Example Problem 17: Full Displaced Left-Turn Intersection (Exhibits 34-146 through 34-150). The same Speedway Blvd (E-W) at Campbell Ave (N-S) intersection as Example Problem 16, with left turns displaced 350 ft upstream on all four approaches, evaluated as two partial DLT analyses (east-west and north-south) sharing the 45-s background cycle of the re-optimized timing plans in Exhibits 34-148 and 34-149. This fixture reproduces the Step 5 offset computation in both directions (Equations 23-63 through 23-68) and the Step 9/10 volume-weighted control-delay aggregation over the five component junctions (Equation 23-69). The five junctions are the two east-west supplemental intersections (Int 1, Int 3), the main intersection (Int 2), and the two north-south supplemental intersections (Int 4, Int 5); the twenty (flow, delay) cells are the Exhibit 34-150 flow and delay grids read together, and their products reproduce the published Products grid cell by cell. Sum of products = 162,373 (162,375 from the unrounded cells), sum of O-D demands = 5,594, ETT_DLT = 29.0 s/veh, LOS C from the Chapter 19 thresholds. The 5,594 total is the original (non-DLT) movement demand total of Exhibit 34-150, which is the same total as Example Problem 16 because the two examples analyze the same conventional intersection.
